objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the XML external entity weakness of a Flask app with a login and a SOAP service and read the flag in /app/flag.txt.
hints: Look at how the server parses the XML you send and whether external entities are resolved.
The application ships with a demo account; its README or login page may tell you more.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which XML parsing weakness lets a document pull in local files?

steps.title: Name the protocol
steps.prompt: Which XML messaging protocol does the service speak?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which weakness gives you a first account without registering?
